name: Rule-defined NJ case-surge task v1; not official outbreak labels
baseline: Trailing7-day mean;28 earlier same-window means from t-7-27 through t-7; latest7 positions excluded to avoid shared raw counts
threshold: baseline mean +2 sample SD; minimum3-day sum5; strict exceedance
confirmation: 2 consecutive qualifying days; onset=second day, never backdate
reset: 7 consecutive nonqualifying days; onset cannot recur while active
forecast: Existing raw direct1/2/3-day predictions clipped at0; no refit
risk: max over future confirmation days of min(two consecutive qualification margins); normalized by max(baselineSD,1); count gate incorporated
eligibility: Origin inactive and baseline defined; predicts new confirmation within1..3days
warning: score > calibrated threshold,7-day cooldown after each issued warning
calibration: Origins2020-04-30..2020-08-28; all targets <=Aug31; Aug29-31 origins omitted
threshold_selection: smallest fixed nonnegative grid threshold with <=1 false warning per30 at-risk ZIP-days in calibration; no assessment tuning
AP: sklearn average_precision_score, step-integrated PR summary; not trapezoidal area
event_matching: earliest issued alert1..3days before confirmation; one-to-one; denominators only events with eligible scored origins
lead_time: reported only for detected events; misses and false alarms reported alongside
limitations: Research proxy labels, not independently adjudicated outbreaks
Onset records missing excluded; retrospective availability assumption
Static2021 covariates and unvalidated ZIP-ZCTA linkage
2020 thresholds/definitions are exploratory; later assessment is not an untouched test
